<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* Lab09: dedicated portal styling. Native widgets retain all their behavior. */
$navy: #101e34;
$blue: #315fe9;
$ink: #182942;
$muted: #607089;
$line: #e1e7ef;

html.sn-sp-page body, body { background: #f6f8fc; color: $ink; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; }
.mf-page, .mf-header { font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; }
.mf-page *, .mf-header * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.mf-page h1, .mf-page h2, .mf-page h3 { font-family: inherit; color: $ink; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
.mf-page a { color: $blue; text-decoration: none; }
.mf-page a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mf-page button, .mf-header button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.mf-page button:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .6; }
.mf-page a:focus-visible, .mf-page button:focus-visible, .mf-page input:focus-visible, .mf-header a:focus-visible, .mf-header button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e9b550; outline-offset: 4px; }
.mf-page .glyphicon, .mf-header .glyphicon { line-height: 1; }

/* Header and opening share one dark surface. */
.mf-header { background: #101e34; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(186,207,238,.1); position: relative; z-index: 20; }
.mf-nav-inner { max-width: 1232px; min-height: 76px; padding: 14px 32px; margin: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; }
.mf-brand { display: inline-flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; color: #fff !important; text-decoration: none !important; }
